prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Sign-in reordering (sign_in, reorder) is helpful, averaging +2.1% after noise correction across 4 tests with 2 wins, though 2 tests showed no clear effect.
Finish redesigns (finish, redesign) are helpful, averaging +2.4% after noise correction across 2 tests with 1 win, though 1 test showed no clear effect.
Evidence is still thin for new adoption screens and flows (adoption, new_screen and adoption, new_flow) with only 1 test each, both showing no clear effect.
Evidence is still thin for path choice redesigns (choose_path, redesign) with only 1 test, which showed no clear effect.
Predictions are often too high, overestimating actual noise-corrected impact in most tests.
Predictions can sometimes underestimate actual impact, as seen in round 6 (+1.5% predicted vs +3.1% noise-corrected) and round 7 (+2.2% predicted vs +4.6% noise-corrected).

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, new_flow: +0.7% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- adoption, new_screen: +0.4% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- choose_path, redesign: +1.0% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, redesign: +2.4% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- sign_in, reorder: +2.1% after noise correction, 4 test(s)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 81.5%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 71.0%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 21.8%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [adoption, redesign] Spotlight layout for pick friend screen: Redesign the friend selection screen using a spotlight layout to highlight individual pet choices and traits. (why: Adoption step has the lowest conversion in the funnel (60.9%), so showcasing pet options clearly increases commitment.)
1: [adoption, new_screen] Photo example reference screen: Add a new preparation guide screen before photo upload showcasing good pet photo examples for best generation results. (why: Support received 3 tickets reporting custom pet generation failing or looking incorrect.)
2: [home, redesign] Stage layout for waiting screen: Rebuild the waiting screen with a stage layout and animated companion rendering progress view. (why: The waiting step has a long mean duration of 2336s and accounts for an 18.7% drop.)
3: [home, notification] Completion notification alert toggle: Enable desktop notification alerts on the waiting screen so users know when their pet finishes generation. (why: Mean wait time is 2336 seconds, causing users to minimize or forget the app while waiting.)
4: [finish, copy] Basic desktop pet interaction guide: Add clear helper text on the home intro screen detailing mouse clicks and shortcuts to hide or talk to the pet. (why: Support logged 3 emails from users unclear on how to control, hide, or talk to their pet after setup.)
5: [choose_path, layout] Split layout for path selection screen: Change choose_path screen layout to split layout to visually present options clearly. (why: Choose path drops 23.8% of users and has an excessively high mean completion time of 514s.)
6: [finish, new_screen] System tray menu quick summary screen: Add a new screen following home intro explaining how to manage desktop pet features from the system tray. (why: 4 support emails reported desktop feature misbehavior or confusion managing active pets.)
7: [home, wait_info] Waiting progress and time display: Enable live time estimates and progress bar on the waiting screen. (why: Users abandon during rendering due to unknown wait times (median 201s, mean 2336s).)
